<h1 id="artifact-fences-marxy-235" data-marxy-s="0" data-marxy-e="29">Artifact fences (MARXY-235)</h1>
<p data-marxy-s="31" data-marxy-e="113">Diff, console, log, ANSI and long-line fixtures for the reader-artifacts handbook.</p>
<h2 id="unified-diff-with-a-long-added-line" data-marxy-s="115" data-marxy-e="153">Unified diff with a long added line</h2>
<pre data-marxy-s="155" data-marxy-e="539"><code class="language-diff" data-marxy-s="163" data-marxy-e="536">@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 context
+this is a very long added line that must wrap in the reader without looking like a new plus line because the continuation hangs past the one-character marker column and keeps the same tint xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
 context
\ No newline at end of file
</code></pre>

total 8
drwxr-xr-x  2 user  staff  64 Sep 25 10:00 .
</code></pre>
